dataset.name: eqFP611 complete 13-site binary combinatorial fluorescence landscape
dataset.selection_reason: Untouched in NABU repository history and experimentally characterized as a complete combinatorial fluorescent-protein landscape with high-order epistasis.

candidate_scope.reason: Stay inside the mutation-count regime already used by the frozen V8.3 hierarchy while ensuring repeated triplet and quartet contexts can exist.

sealed_split.hidden: buckets 7-9 identities only in Stage A

architecture.name: NABU V8.3 Dual-Objective Router
architecture.global_gate: if visible OOF B4 Spearman > B3 OOF Spearman, use global B5
architecture.elite_gate: otherwise allow rank-preserving B5 rerank inside frozen B3 top-20% only if visible OOF elite Top-50 mean percentile improves and Top-1%-hit count does not decrease

stage_a_qualification_gate.action_if_not_met: ABORT BEFORE REVEAL; benchmark does not count as a higher-order test

primary_endpoints: Top-50 count of true hidden Top-1% variants

anti_leakage.stage_0: package visible labels, hidden identities, sealed hidden truth; do not print hidden fitness values
anti_leakage.stage_A: fit frozen V8.3, verify HO support gate, score hidden identities, freeze candidates and hashes, exit
anti_leakage.stage_B: verify all hashes, then load sealed hidden truth exactly once and evaluate
